tasks.title: Partner payment timeouts are misclassified
tasks.problem: Harborline Logistics' warehouse retries are treating an upstream timeout as a hard card decline, delaying order fulfillment.
tasks.tribal: Payment codes are append-only per module; partner integrations use numeric ranges and api/errors.yaml generates both Go messages and TypeScript mappings.

tasks.title: Compliance export gate differs by tenant
tasks.problem: The compliance rollout flag appears enabled in some tenant environments but disabled in others after a control-plane sync.
tasks.tribal: The SQL seed's dotted lowercase spelling is canonical; Go uses kebab case, Kubernetes uses uppercase underscores, and cache invalidation has a separate registry.

tasks.title: Tenant grace-period overrides silently fall back
tasks.problem: Harborline's configured seven-day grace period is ignored for invoices created by the regional import job.
tasks.tribal: Override keys are seeded as dotted lowercase in SQL; old imports submit mixed-case underscore names, while reads currently only lowercase.

tasks.title: Container pool setting is ignored in production
tasks.problem: The new database pool ceiling is present in the deployment manifest, but pods still start with the generated default and queue invoice writes.
tasks.tribal: Compose and Go use different historical environment prefixes; generated defaults run during build, and the deployment uses a separate env alias.

tasks.title: Optional partner URL is indistinguishable from an empty value
tasks.problem: Self-hosted customers with no partner webhook configured are being treated as if they explicitly configured an empty endpoint.
tasks.tribal: Value-vs-unset follows migration guarantees; confdiff interprets pointers as runtime-optional and zero values as guaranteed defaults.

tasks.title: Historical invoice events fail replay after a field rename
tasks.problem: Finance's reconciliation replay rejects persisted invoice events written by older server versions.
tasks.tribal: Event payloads are append-only and decoded through both JSON and mapstructure; stored tag names are a compatibility contract, not cosmetic struct labels.

tasks.title: Async invoice export loses tenant context
tasks.problem: A queued export occasionally reads the default tenant after being launched from a tenant-specific invoice route.
tasks.tribal: Workers replay handlers without HTTP middleware; tenant identity must be carried in the route-created context/envelope, not reconstructed from headers.

tasks.title: Generated error catalogs drift between services
tasks.problem: The console shows raw error codes for a partner-facing error while Go logs show a friendly message for the same response.
tasks.tribal: api/errors.yaml is the only source of truth; generated Go and TypeScript files must be regenerated together, and reserved module blocks are not allocated by alphabetical order.

tasks.title: GDPR audit export exposes personal data
tasks.problem: Crestwood Dental's erasure review found personal identifiers in the admin audit export despite the ordinary event endpoint masking them.
tasks.tribal: The hand-written marshaler and generated easyjson path differ; all serialization boundaries, including the fast export path, must use the redaction policy and the compliance flag.

tasks.title: Released binary serves yesterday's console bundle
tasks.problem: The API deployment contains the new invoice screen assets in the workspace, but the compiled binary continues to serve the prior version.
tasks.tribal: The Go binary embeds web/dist at compile time; Docker's build context can contain a stale bundle unless the frontend build stage precedes Go compilation.

tasks.title: Fresh environments start before schema migrations
tasks.problem: A new staging region boots the service successfully, then fails the first invoice write because the required tables are absent.
tasks.tribal: make run generates code but does not apply migrations; onboarding expects a distinct migration prerequisite and migration ordering is filename-based.

tasks.title: New invoice status breaks finance's workbook mapping
tasks.problem: Finance's monthly workbook imports the new review state as a paid invoice, distorting cash forecasts.
tasks.tribal: Status strings and ordinal positions are an external report contract; report_schema_version must be bumped and the generated string mapping refreshed.

tasks.title: Webhook subscription from another subsidiary is selected
tasks.problem: A subsidiary received an invoice notification intended for a similarly named account in another organization.
tasks.tribal: Subscriptions have both a static fallback registry and a DB-loaded registry; tenant scoping was added to the database path later, leaving the fallback lookup keyed only by name.

tasks.title: Invoice preview cancellation leaves billable work running
tasks.problem: Users navigate away from expensive invoice previews, but worker capacity remains occupied until the full calculation finishes.
tasks.tribal: Jobs intentionally outlive HTTP request contexts; the supported cancellation path is Runner.Cancel(jobID), and preview jobs must retain their stable job ID across retries.

tasks.title: Tenant export throttles disagree between edge and API
tasks.problem: Large audit exports are rejected by nginx at one rate and by the Go service at another, causing confusing retry behavior.
tasks.tribal: configs/ratelimits.yaml is shared with the nginx generated snippet; scope names and values must match, and tenant export uses a separate bucket from global API traffic.

tasks.title: Invoice line versions advance before the event is durable
tasks.problem: A retry after a broker interruption is rejected as stale even though downstream consumers never received the prior line-item update.
tasks.tribal: The outbox consumer is writer of record; version advancement happens only after durable publish/consumer application, not when the HTTP producer assembles the event.

tasks.title: Totals cache returns another tenant's cached summary
tasks.problem: After a tenant migration, two customers intermittently see the same cached invoice total on the dashboard.
tasks.tribal: Legacy keys have two segments; current keys require a tenant segment. Both formats parse, so the cache layer must use the shared CacheKey helper and isolate legacy invalidation.

tasks.title: Workspace switch shows stale tenant invoice data
tasks.problem: Vantage Foods users see Harborline invoice counts after switching workspaces until a full page reload.
tasks.tribal: Tenant store is an SSR snapshot; useSyncExternalStore is the subscription contract and tenant-derived caches must be invalidated on switch.

tasks.title: Pagination returns stale invoices after navigation
tasks.problem: Returning to a paginated invoice list shows rows from the prior tenant/page even though the URL has changed.
tasks.tribal: Most SWR keys are generated from routes.yaml; the invoice page has a local historical literal that must preserve both tenant and page dimensions when its contract changes.

tasks.title: Billing API is reachable without a session in app-router profile
tasks.problem: A security review found anonymous requests can reach billing endpoints after production enabled the app-router middleware profile.
tasks.tribal: Legacy and v2 middleware coexist behind a deployment profile; matcher coverage must be equivalent even though both files compile and old profile tests pass.

tasks.title: Autosave rejects an intentionally incomplete draft
tasks.problem: Users cannot save a partially completed purchase order while working through the required fields, though final submission must remain strict.
tasks.tribal: Frontend required means user guidance; backend validation allows missing values during draft autosave and enforces the full schema only on submit.

tasks.title: Audit filters disappear on browser back navigation
tasks.problem: A finance analyst filters audit events, opens a record, then returns to an unfiltered table with stale cached results.
tasks.tribal: Filter state belongs in URL search parameters and the cache key; useFilteredTable serializes filters in fixed field order for stable keys.

tasks.title: New backend error has no localized console message
tasks.problem: German and French tenants see a raw numeric code when a new payment state is returned by the API.
tasks.tribal: errcodes_gen.ts provides generated English fallback; hand-maintained locale tables are intentionally incomplete and must fall back through the generated message map.

tasks.title: Frontend build leaks a server-only integration setting
tasks.problem: A deployment audit flags an integration credential in the web build environment; the browser needs only the public API origin.
tasks.tribal: Only NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables may enter the bundle; server values come from the 1Password environment item and CI's scanner must inspect build inputs as well as source literals.

tasks.title: Feature flag flickers during authenticated hydration
tasks.problem: Signed-in users briefly see a feature-enabled screen that disappears after the server-provided tenant policy loads.
tasks.tribal: Authenticated rendering must use window.__MERIDIAN__ from the server; localStorage is only a logged-out fallback and reading it during render violates hydration parity.

tasks.title: Payroll export inserts a component in the wrong spreadsheet column
tasks.problem: Finance's January workbook maps a new shift differential into the retirement column because component ordering changed.
tasks.tribal: Column position is contractual across the Go export and frontend labels; new components append only after reserved positions and schema versions identify the layout.

tasks.title: Bulk procurement removal omits required audit context
tasks.problem: A bulk cleanup request deletes purchase orders without the compliance note required for retention review.
tasks.tribal: Single-record helper is retained for compatibility; bulk removal must use the separate transactional helper and persist a non-empty audit note for every affected id.

tasks.title: Legacy event stream rejects valid signed-in browser sessions
tasks.problem: The old pages server's event stream drops authenticated users because EventSource cannot attach the standard authorization header.
tasks.tribal: Only the legacy SSE endpoint permits a short-lived query token; the app-router handler must continue requiring the normal session cookie.

tasks.title: Payroll labels no longer line up with exported pay columns
tasks.problem: A new payroll component shifts labels for downstream columns in the CSV preview and finance's workbook.
tasks.tribal: The Go column registry and TypeScript positional array are mirrors; the payroll schema version and explicit order check are the cross-language contract.

tasks.title: Overdue badge differs from the tenant's local business date
tasks.problem: A Denver tenant sees an invoice marked overdue the evening before its local due date, while UTC reports say it is still current.
tasks.tribal: Overdue is defined by tenant-local calendar date; the denormalized field is refreshed by a backfill job that must receive tenant timezone, not host timezone.

tasks.title: Concurrent payment retries can charge the same attempt twice
tasks.problem: A gateway timeout triggers overlapping retry workers and the ledger records two charges for a single payment attempt.
tasks.tribal: Idempotency keys are per attempt because the ledger reconciler groups on that value; retries within an attempt must reuse it, while a new attempt advances the attempt sequence.

tasks.title: Audit replay fails on records written before the schema expansion
tasks.problem: A partner's historical audit export cannot be replayed after a new optional actor field was introduced.
tasks.tribal: Old rows pass through the version-1 decoder shim; new fields require an explicit opt-in/default in that shim because stored snapshots predate the field.
